subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` turns permanently require `final=true` for confirmed current-source delivery to end the turn, or should confirmed delivery remain implicitly terminal with prompt steering only?
rationale: Upstream Codex provides no terminal-delivery primitive, so both choices are OpenClaw-owned and establish incompatible behavior when the model omits the optional field.

options.title: Require explicit final
options.body: Adopt the structural contract on one current-main branch, limited to Codex `message_tool_only`, with full omission and routing coverage.

options.title: Keep implicit completion
options.body: Preserve confirmed-delivery terminal behavior and select the prompt-only candidate, accepting residual early-termination risk when instructions are ignored.

options.title: Defer completion API
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause all implementation branches until maintainers sponsor a permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Require explicit final
recommendation.body: Adopt the structural contract on one current-main branch, limited to Codex `message_tool_only`, with full omission and routing coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the confirmed source-delivery terminal behavior whose permanent semantics now need calibration.
